<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="Sp1nd01" />{{rh|The generations|Chap.xij.|of Terah. Abram.}}
{{rule}}</noinclude>and begate Arphaxad two years after the Flood.

{{verse|11|11}}And Shem liued, after he begate Arphaxad, fiue hundred yeeres, and begate ſonnes and daughters.

{{verse|11|12}}And Arphaxad liued fiue and thirtie yeeres, and begate Salah.

{{verse|11|13}}And Arphaxad liued, after he begate Salah, foure hundred and three yeeres, and begate ſonnes and daughters.

{{verse|11|14}}And Salah liued thirtie yeeres, and begate Eber.

{{verse|11|15}}And Salah liued, after hee begate Eber, foure hundred and three yeeres, and begate ſonnes and daughters.

{{verse|11|16}}*{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* 1.Chron.1.19.}} And Eber liued foure and thirty yeeres, and begate *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* Called Luke 3.35. Phalec.}} Peleg.

{{verse|11|17}}And Eber liued, after hee begate Peleg, foure hundred and thirty yeres, and begate ſonnes and daughters.

{{verse|11|18}}And Peleg liued thirtie yeeres, and begate Reu.

{{verse|11|19}}And Peleg liued, after hee begate Reu, two hundred and nine yeeres, and begate ſonnes and daughters.

{{verse|11|20}}And Reu liued two and thirtie yeeres, and begate *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* Luc.5.35. Saruch.}} Serug.

{{verse|11|21}}And Reu liued, after hee begate Serug, two hundreth and ſeuen yeres, and begate ſonnes and daughters.

{{verse|11|22}}And Serug liued thirtie yeeres, and begate Nahor.

{{verse|11|23}}And Serug liued, after he begate Nahor, two hundred yeeres, and begat ſonnes and daughters.

{{verse|11|24}}And Nahor liued nine and twentie yeeres, and begate *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* Luc.3.34. Thara.}} Terah.

{{verse|11|25}}And Nahor liued, after he begate Terah, an hundred ⁊ nineteene yeeres, and begate ſonnes and daughters.

{{verse|11|26}}And Terah liued ſeuenty yeeres, and *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* Ioſh.24.2 1.Chron.1.26.}} begate Abram, Nahor, ⁊ Haran.

{{verse|11|27}}¶ Now theſe {{smaller|are}} the generations of Terah: Terah begate Abram, Nahor, and Haran: And Haran begate Lot.

{{verse|11|28}}And Haran died, before his father Terah in the land of his natiuity, in Vr of the Chaldees.

{{verse|11|29}}And Abram and Nahor tooke them wiues: the name of Abrams wife {{smaller|was}} Sarai, and the name of Nahors wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iſcah.

{{verse|11|30}}But Sarai was barren; ſhe {{smaller|had}} no childe.

{{verse|11|31}}And Terah tooke Abram his ſonne, and Lot the ſonne of Haran his ſonnes ſonne, and Sarai his daughter in lawe, his ſonne Abrams wife, and they went foorth with them from *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* Nehem.9.7. iudith.5.7. acts.7.4.}} Vr of the Chaldees, to goe into the land of Canaan: and they came vnto Haran, and dwelt there.

{{verse|11|32}}And the dayes of Terah, were two hundred and fiue yeres: and Terah died in Haran.

==={{Chapter|12|CHAP. XII.}}===

{{smaller block|[[#12:1|1]] God calleth Abram, and bleſſeth him with a promiſe of Chriſt. [[#12:4|4]] He departeth with Lot from Haran. [[#12:6|6]] He iourneyeth through Canaan, [[#12:7|7]] which is promiſed him in a viſion. [[#12:10|10]] Hee is driuen by a famine into Egypt. [[#12:11|11]] Feare maketh him faine his wife to be his ſiſter. [[#12:14|14]] Pharaoh hauing taken her from him, by plagues is compelled to reſtore her.}}

{{Verse|12|1|notext=}} {{dropinitial|N|image=King James Bible (1611) page A3r (N).png|imgsize=100px}}Ow the *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* Acts.7.3.}} LORD had ſaid vnto Abram, Get thee out of thy countrey, and from thy kinred, and from thy fathers houſe, vnto a land that I will ſhew thee.

{{verse|12|2}}And I will make of thee a great nation, and I wil bleſſe thee, and make thy name great; and thou ſhalt bee a bleſſing.

{{verse|12|3}}And I will bleſſe them that bleſſe thee, and curſe him, that curſeth thee: *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* Chap.18.18. and 22.18. acts.3.25. galat.3.8.}} and in thee ſhal all families of the earth be bleſſed.

{{verse|12|4}}So Abram departed, as the LORD had ſpoken vnto him, and Lot went with him: And Abram {{smaller|was}} ſeuentie and fiue yeeres old when he departed out of Haran.

{{verse|12|5}}And Abram tooke Sarai his wife, and Lot his brothers ſonne, and all their ſubſtance that they had gathered, and the ſoules that they had gotten in Haran, and they went foorth to goe into the land of Canaan: and into the land of Canaan they came.

{{verse|12|6}}¶ and Abram paſſed through the land, vnto the place of Sichem, vnto the plaine of Moreh. And the Canaanite {{smaller|was}} then in the land.

{{verse|12|7}}And the LORD appeared vnto Abram, and ſaid, *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* Chap.13.15.}} Vnto thy ſeed wil I giue this land: and there builded hee an *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* Chap.13.4.}} altar vnto the LORD< who appeared vnto him.

{{verse|12|8}}And he remoued from thence vnto a mountaine, on the Eaſt of the Beth⸗el, and pitched his tent {{smaller|hauing}} Beth⸗el on the<noinclude></noinclude>
